content: Hivyo Bwana akawaokoa Waisraeli siku ile, navyo vita vilienea hadi kupita Beth-Aveni.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Basi watu wa Israeli walikuwa katika dhiki siku ile, kwa sababu Sauli alikuwa amewafunga watu kwa kiapo, akisema, “Alaaniwe mtu yeyote ambaye atakula chakula kabla ya jioni, kabla sijalipiza kisasi juu ya adui zangu!” Kwa hiyo hakuna mtu yeyote katika jeshi aliyeonja chakula.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Jeshi lote liliingia mwituni, na huko kulikuwepo na asali ardhini.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Walipoingia mwituni, wakaona asali ikitiririka, hata hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote aliyetia mkono wake kinywani, kwa sababu waliogopa kiapo.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Lakini Yonathani alikuwa hajasikia kuwa baba yake alikuwa amewafunga watu kwa kiapo, hivyo akainyoosha ncha ya fimbo iliyokuwa mkononi mwake na kuichovya katika sega la asali. Akainua mkono wake na kuutia kinywani mwake, nayo macho yake yakawa maangavu.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Kisha mmoja wa askari wake akamwambia, “Baba yako alilifunga jeshi kwa kiapo kikali, akisema, ‘Alaaniwe mtu yeyote alaye chakula leo!’ Ndiyo sababu watu wanalegea.”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Yonathani akasema, “Baba yangu ameitaabisha nchi. Ona jinsi nilivyopata nguvu mpya nilipoonja asali hii kidogo.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Ingekuwa bora zaidi mara ngapi kama watu wangalikula leo baadhi ya nyara walizoteka kutoka kwa adui zao. Je, mauaji ya Wafilisti yasingekuwa makubwa zaidi?”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Siku ile baada ya Waisraeli kuwaua Wafilisti kutoka Mikmashi mpaka Aiyaloni, walikuwa wamechoka.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Watu wakarukia zile nyara, wakichukua kondoo, ngʼombe na ndama, wakawachinja hapo juu ya nchi na kuwala, pamoja na damu.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content:
Kisha mtu mmoja akamwambia Sauli, “Tazama, watu wanatenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana kwa kula nyama yenye damu.”
    Akasema, “Mmevunja uaminifu. Livingirisheni jiwe kubwa hapa mara moja.”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content:
Kisha Sauli akasema, “Nendeni miongoni mwa watu, mwaambie, ‘Kila mmoja wenu aniletee ngʼombe wake na kondoo, mwachinjie hapa na mle. Msitende dhambi dhidi ya Bwana kwa kula nyama ikiwa na damu ndani yake.’ ”
    Hivyo kila mmoja akaleta ngʼombe wake jioni ile na kumchinja hapo.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Ndipo Sauli akamjengea Bwana madhabahu, na ndiyo ilivyokuwa mara yake ya kwanza kujenga madhabahu.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content:
Sauli akasema, “Tuteremke tufuatie Wafilisti usiku na kuwateka nyara mpaka mapambazuko, nasi tusiache hata mmoja wao hai.”
    Wakajibu, “Fanya lolote lile uonalo jema zaidi kwako.”
    Lakini kuhani akasema, “Tuulize kwa Mungu mahali hapa.”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Basi Sauli akamuuliza Mungu, akisema, “Je, niteremke kuwafuatia Wafilisti? Je, utawatia mikononi mwa Israeli?” Lakini Mungu hakumjibu siku ile.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Kwa hiyo Sauli akasema, “Njooni hapa, ninyi nyote ambao ni viongozi wa jeshi, na tutafute ni dhambi gani imefanywa leo.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Kwa hakika kama Bwana aiokoaye Israeli aishivyo, hata kama itakuwa juu ya mwana wangu Yonathani, ni lazima afe.” Lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyesema neno.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content:
Kisha Sauli akawaambia Waisraeli wote, “Ninyi simameni huko; mimi na mwanangu Yonathani tutasimama hapa.”
    Watu wakajibu, “Fanya lile unaloona jema zaidi kwako.”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Kisha Sauli akamwomba Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, akisema, “Nipe jibu lililo sawa.” Yonathani na Sauli wakatolewa kwa kura, nao watu wakawa salama.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Sauli akasema, “Pigeni kura kati yangu na mwanangu Yonathani.” Kura ikamwangukia Yonathani.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content:
Basi Sauli akamwambia Yonathani, “Niambie ni nini ulichokifanya.”
    Hivyo Yonathani akamwambia, “Nilionja tu asali kidogo kwa ncha ya fimbo yangu. Je, sasa ni lazima nife?”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Sauli akasema, “Mungu na anishughulikie kwa ukali zaidi kama wewe Yonathani hutakufa.”

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Lakini watu wakamwambia Sauli, “Je, Yonathani atakufa, yeye ambaye ameleta wokovu huu mkubwa Israeli? Hasha! Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, hakuna hata unywele wa kichwa chake utakaoanguka juu ya ardhi, kwa kuwa alifanya jambo hili leo kwa msaada wa Mungu.” Basi watu wakamwokoa Yonathani, wala hakuuawa.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Kisha Sauli akaacha kuwafuata Wafilisti, nao wakajiondoa na kurudi katika nchi yao.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Baada ya Sauli kujitwalia utawala katika Israeli, alipigana dhidi ya adui zake kila upande: Moabu, Waamoni, Edomu, wafalme wa Soba, na Wafilisti. Popote alipogeukia, aliwashinda.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Akapigana kishujaa na kuwashinda Waamaleki, akiikomboa Israeli kutoka mikono ya wale waliokuwa wamewateka nyara.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Wana wa Sauli walikuwa Yonathani, Ishvi na Malki-Shua. Jina la binti yake mkubwa lilikuwa Merabu, naye mdogo aliitwa Mikali.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Jina la mkewe Sauli aliitwa Ahinoamu binti wa Ahimaasi. Jina la jemadari wa jeshi la Sauli aliitwa Abneri mwana wa Neri, naye Neri alikuwa babaye mdogo Sauli.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Babaye Sauli yaani, Kishi na Neri baba yake Abneri walikuwa wana wa Abieli.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Siku zote za utawala wa Sauli zilikuwa za vita vikali dhidi ya Wafilisti, na wakati wowote Sauli alimwona mtu mwenye nguvu au shujaa, alimchukua kwa utumishi wake.

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

teaching.description: SAULI AMWASI MUNGU: USHINDI WA YONATHANI JUU YA WAFILISTI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 13:1-14:52

content: Samweli akamwambia Sauli, “Mimi ndiye ambaye Bwana alinituma nikutie mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya watu wake Israeli, basi sasa sikiliza ujumbe kutoka kwa Bwana.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: ‘Nitawaadhibu Waamaleki kwa kile walichowatendea Israeli walipowavizia wakati walipanda kutoka Misri.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Basi sasa nenda ukawashambulie Waamaleki na kuwaangamiza kabisa pamoja na kila kitu kilicho mali yao. Usiwahurumie; waue wanaume na wanawake, watoto na wanyonyao, ngʼombe na kondoo, ngamia na punda.’ ”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Sauli akaenda katika mji wa Amaleki na kuwavizia bondeni.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Kisha akawaambia Wakeni, “Ondokeni, waacheni Waamaleki ili nisije nikawaangamiza ninyi pamoja nao, kwa kuwa ninyi mliwatendea mema Waisraeli wote wakati walipanda kutoka Misri.” Basi Wakeni wakaondoka, wakawaacha Waamaleki.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Ndipo Sauli akawashambulia Waamaleki toka Havila mpaka Shuri, hadi mashariki ya Misri.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Akamchukua Agagi, mfalme wa Waamaleki akiwa hai, nao watu wake wote akawaangamiza kabisa kwa upanga.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Lakini Sauli na hilo jeshi wakamhifadhi hai Agagi na kondoo na ngʼombe walio wazuri, mafahali na wana-kondoo walionona kila kitu kilichokuwa kizuri. Hivi vitu hawakuwa radhi kuviangamiza kabisa, bali kila kitu kilichodharauliwa na kilicho dhaifu wakakiangamiza kabisa.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Kisha neno la Bwana likamjia Samweli kusema:

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: “Ninasikitika kwamba nimemfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme, kwa sababu ameacha kunifuata mimi na hakutimiza maagizo yangu.” Samweli akafadhaika, naye akamlilia Bwana usiku ule wote.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Asubuhi na mapema Samweli akaamka kwenda kukutana na Sauli, lakini akaambiwa, “Sauli amekwenda Karmeli. Huko amesimamisha mnara kwa heshima yake mwenyewe naye ameendelea na kuteremkia Gilgali.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Samweli alipomfikia, Sauli akamwambia, “Bwana akubariki! Nimetimiza yale Bwana aliniagiza.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Lakini Samweli akasema, “Nini basi huu mlio wa kondoo masikioni mwangu? Huu mlio wa ngʼombe ninaousikia ni kitu gani?”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Sauli akajibu, “Askari wamewaleta kutoka kwa Waamaleki, waliwaacha wale kondoo na ngʼombe wazuri ili kuwatoa dhabihu kwa Bwana, Mungu wako, lakini tuliwaangamiza kabisa wengine wote.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content:
Samweli akamwambia Sauli, “Ngoja! Nami nitakuambia lile Bwana aliloniambia usiku huu.”
    Sauli akajibu, “Niambie.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Samweli akamwambia, “Ingawa zamani ulijiona mdogo machoni pako mwenyewe, Je, hukuwa kiongozi wa kabila za Israeli? Bwana alikutia mafuta kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Naye akakutuma kwa kazi maalum, akisema, ‘Nenda ukaangamize kabisa wale watu waovu, wale Waamaleki, upigane nao vita mpaka utakapowaangamiza kabisa.’

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Kwa nini hukumtii Bwana? Kwa nini ulivamia nyara na kufanya uovu machoni pa Bwana?”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Sauli akasema, “Lakini nilimtii Bwana. Nilikamilisha ile kazi ambayo Bwana alinituma. Niliwaangamiza Waamaleki kabisa na kumleta Agagi mfalme wao.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Askari walichukua kondoo na ngʼombe kutoka kwenye nyara, zile ambazo ni nzuri sana zimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu, ili zitolewe dhabihu kwa Bwana Mungu wako huko Gilgali.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content:
Lakini Samweli akajibu:
  “Je, Bwana anafurahia sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu
    kama vile kuitii sauti ya Bwana?
  Kutii ni bora zaidi kuliko dhabihu,
    nako kusikia ni bora
    kuliko mafuta ya kondoo dume.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content:
Kwa maana kuasi ni kama dhambi ya uaguzi,
    nao ukaidi ni kama uovu wa kuabudu sanamu.
  Kwa sababu umelikataa neno la Bwana,
    naye amekukataa wewe
    kuendelea kuwa mfalme.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Ndipo Sauli akamwambia Samweli, “Nimetenda dhambi. Nimevunja amri ya Bwana na maagizo yako. Niliwaogopa watu na kwa hiyo nikafanya walivyotaka.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Sasa ninakusihi usamehe dhambi yangu, nawe urudi pamoja nami, ili nipate kumwabudu Bwana.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Lakini Samweli akamwambia, “Sitarudi pamoja nawe. Umelikataa neno la Bwana, naye Bwana amekukataa wewe, usiendelee kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli!”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Samweli alipogeuka ili aondoke, Sauli akangʼangʼania pindo la joho lake, nalo likararuka.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Samweli akamwambia, “Bwana ameurarua ufalme wa Israeli kutoka kwako leo, naye ameutia kwa mmoja wa majirani zako, aliye bora kuliko wewe.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Yeye aliye Utukufu wa Israeli hasemi uongo wala hana kigeugeu; kwa kuwa yeye si mwanadamu, hata abadili nia yake.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Sauli akajibu, “Nimetenda dhambi. Lakini tafadhali niheshimu mbele ya wazee wa watu wangu na mbele ya Israeli; rudi pamoja nami, ili nipate kumwabudu Bwana Mungu wako.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Hivyo Samweli akarudi pamoja na Sauli, naye Sauli akamwabudu Bwana.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content:
Ndipo Samweli akasema, “Niletee Agagi mfalme wa Waamaleki.”
    Agagi akaja kwake kwa ujasiri, akifikiri, “Hakika uchungu wa mauti umepita.”

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content:
Lakini Samweli akasema,
  “Kama upanga wako ulivyofanya wanawake
    kufiwa na watoto wao,
  ndivyo mama yako atakavyokuwa
    hana mtoto miongoni mwa wanawake.”
Naye Samweli akamuua Agagi mbele za Bwana huko Gilgali.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Kisha Samweli akaenda Rama, lakini Sauli akapanda nyumbani kwake huko Gibea ya Sauli.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Hadi siku Samweli alipofariki hakwenda kumwona Sauli tena, ingawa Samweli alimwombolezea. Naye Bwana alihuzunika kwamba alimfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

teaching.description: UASI WA SAULI KUMHUSU AGAGI MFLAME WA AMALEKI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 15

content: Bwana akamwambia Samweli, “Utamlilia Sauli mpaka lini, maadamu nimemkataa asiendelee kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli? Jaza pembe yako mafuta, ushike njia uende; ninakutuma kwa Yese huko Bethlehemu. Nimemchagua mmoja wa wanawe kuwa mfalme.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Lakini Samweli akasema, “Nitakwendaje? Sauli atasikia juu ya jambo hili na ataniua.”
    Bwana akamwambia, “Chukua mtamba wa ngʼombe na useme, ‘Nimekuja kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.’

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mwalike Yese aje kwenye dhabihu, nami nitakuonyesha utakalofanya. Utamtia mafuta kwa ajili yangu yule nitakayekuonyesha.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Samweli akafanya kile Bwana alichosema. Alipofika Bethlehemu, wazee wa mji wakatetemeka walipomlaki. Wakauliza, “Je, umekuja kwa amani?”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Samweli akajibu, “Ndiyo, kwa amani; nimekuja kumtolea Bwana dhabihu. Jiwekeni wakfu na mje kwenye dhabihu pamoja nami.” Ndipo akamweka Yese wakfu pamoja na wanawe na kuwaalika kwenye dhabihu.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Walipofika, Samweli akamwona Eliabu, naye akafikiri, “Hakika mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana anasimama hapa mbele za Bwana.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Samweli, “Usitazame sura yake wala kimo chake, kwa kuwa nimemkataa. Bwana hatazami katika vile vitu mwanadamu avitazamavyo. Mwanadamu hutazama katika sura ya nje, lakini Bwana hutazama moyoni.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kisha Yese akamwita Abinadabu na kumpitisha mbele ya Samweli. Lakini Samweli akasema, “Hata huyu Bwana hakumchagua.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kisha Yese akampitisha Shama, lakini Samweli akasema, “Wala huyu Bwana hakumchagua.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Yese alikuwa na wana saba aliowapitisha mbele ya Samweli, lakini Samweli akamwambia, “Bwana hajawachagua hawa.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Hivyo akamuuliza Yese, “Je, hawa ndio wana pekee ulio nao?”
    Yese akajibu, “Bado yuko mdogo kuliko wote, lakini anachunga kondoo.”
    Samweli akasema, “Tuma aitwe; hatutaketi mpaka afike.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Basi akatuma aitwe naye akaletwa. Alikuwa mwekundu, mwenye sura nzuri na umbo la kupendeza.
    Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Inuka na umtie mafuta, huyu ndiye.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Samweli akachukua ile pembe ya mafuta na kumtia mafuta mbele ya ndugu zake, kuanzia siku ile na kuendelea Roho wa Bwana akaja juu ya Daudi kwa nguvu. Kisha Samweli akaenda zake Rama.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Roho wa Bwana alikuwa ameondoka kwa Sauli, nayo roho mbaya ikaachiwa nafasi na Bwana ili imtese.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Watumishi wa Sauli wakamwambia, “Angalia, roho mbaya imeachiwa nafasi na Bwana nayo inakutesa.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi bwana wetu na aamuru watumishi wake walioko hapa kutafuta mtu ambaye anaweza kupiga kinubi. Atakipiga kinubi wakati roho mbaya iliyoachiwa nafasi na Mungu ikujiapo, nawe utajisikia vizuri.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Sauli akawaambia watumishi wake, “Mtafuteni mtu apigaye kinubi vizuri mkamlete kwangu.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mmoja wa watumishi wake akajibu, “Nimemwona mwana wa Yese Mbethlehemu ambaye anajua kupiga kinubi. Yeye ni mtu hodari na shujaa wa vita. Ni mwenye busara katika kunena, mtu mzuri wa umbo. Bwana yu pamoja naye.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Ndipo Sauli akatuma wajumbe kwa Yese na kumwambia, “Nitumie mwanao Daudi, ambaye anachunga kondoo.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kwa hiyo Yese akamchukua punda aliyepakizwa mikate, kiriba cha divai na mwana-mbuzi, na kuvipeleka vitu hivyo kwa Sauli pamoja na Daudi mwanawe.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akafika kwa Sauli na kuingia kwenye kazi yake. Sauli akampenda sana, naye Daudi akawa mmoja wa wabeba silaha wake.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Sauli akatuma ujumbe kwa Yese, akisema, “Mruhusu Daudi abaki katika utumishi wangu, kwa kuwa ninapendezwa naye.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kila mara roho mbaya iliyoachiwa nafasi na Mungu ilipomjia Sauli, Daudi alichukua kinubi chake na kupiga. Ndipo Sauli angetulizwa na kujisikia vizuri, nayo ile roho mbaya ingemwacha.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wakati huu Wafilisti wakakusanya majeshi yao kwa ajili ya vita, nao wakakusanyika huko Soko katika Yuda. Wakapiga kambi huko Efes-Damimu, kati ya Soko na Azeka.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Sauli na Waisraeli wakakusanyika na kupiga kambi katika Bonde la Ela na kupanga jeshi ili kupigana vita na Wafilisti.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wafilisti wakawa katika kilima kimoja na Waisraeli katika kilima kingine, hilo bonde likiwa kati yao.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Shujaa aliyeitwa Goliathi, aliyetoka Gathi, akajitokeza kutoka kambi ya Wafilisti. Alikuwa na urefu dhiraa sita na shibiri moja.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Alikuwa na chapeo ya shaba kichwani mwake, na alivaa dirii ya shaba kifuani mwake yenye uzito wa shekeli elfu tano.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Miguuni mwake alivaa mabamba ya shaba, na alikuwa na mkuki wa shaba mgongoni mwake.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mpini wa huo mkuki ulikuwa kama mti wa mfumaji, na ncha ya chuma yake ilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli mia sita. Mbeba ngao wake alitangulia mbele yake.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Goliathi alisimama na kuwapigia kelele majeshi ya Israeli, akisema, “Kwa nini mmetoka kupanga vita? Je, mimi si Mfilisti, na ninyi ni watumishi wa Sauli? Chagueni mtu na anishukie mimi.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kama anaweza kupigana nami na kuniua, tutakuwa chini yenu; lakini kama nikimshinda na kumuua, ninyi mtakuwa chini yetu na mtatutumikia.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kisha yule Mfilisti akasema, “Siku hii ya leo nayatukana majeshi ya Israeli! Nipeni mtu tupigane.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kwa kusikia maneno ya Wafilisti, Sauli na Waisraeli wote wakafadhaika na kuogopa.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Daudi alikuwa mwana wa Mwefrathi jina lake Yese aliyekuwa ametoka Bethlehemu ya Yuda. Yese alikuwa na wana wanane, naye wakati wa Sauli alikuwa mzee tena wa umri mkubwa.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wana wakubwa watatu wa Yese walikuwa wamefuatana na Sauli vitani: Mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Eliabu, wa pili Abinadabu, na wa tatu Shama.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi ndiye alikuwa mdogo wa wote. Hao wakubwa watatu wakamfuata Sauli,

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: lakini Daudi alikuwa akienda kwa Sauli na kurudi ili kuchunga kondoo wa baba yake huko Bethlehemu.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kwa siku arobaini huyo Mfilisti alikuwa akija mbele kila siku asubuhi na jioni na kujionyesha.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wakati huo Yese akamwambia mwanawe Daudi, “Chukua hii efa ya bisi na hii mikate kumi kwa ajili ya ndugu zako uwapelekee upesi kambini mwao.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Chukua pamoja na hizi jibini kumi kwa jemadari wa kikosi chao. Ujue hali ya ndugu zako na uniletee taarifa za uhakika kutoka kwao.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wao wako pamoja na Sauli na watu wote wa Israeli huko kwenye Bonde la Ela, wakipigana na Wafilisti.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Asubuhi na mapema Daudi akaondoka, akaliacha kundi la kondoo pamoja na mchungaji, akapakia vitu vile na kuondoka, kama vile Yese alivyokuwa amemwagiza. Akafika kambini wakati jeshi lilikuwa likitoka kwenda kwenye sehemu yake ya kupigania, huku wakipiga kelele za vita.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Israeli na Wafilisti walikuwa wakipanga safu zao wakitazamana.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akaacha vile vitu vyake kwa mtunza vifaa, akakimbilia katika safu za vita na kuwasalimu ndugu zake.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Alipokuwa akisema nao, Goliathi, yule Mfilisti shujaa kutoka Gathi, akajitokeza mbele ya safu zake na kupiga ile kelele yake ya kawaida ya matukano, naye Daudi akayasikia.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Waisraeli walipomwona yule mtu, wote wakamkimbia kwa woga mkuu.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Waisraeli walikuwa wakisema, “Je, mnaona jinsi mtu huyu anavyoendelea kujitokeza. Hujitokeza ili kutukana Israeli. Mfalme atatoa utajiri mwingi kwa yule mtu atakayemuua. Pia atamwoza binti yake na atasamehe jamaa ya baba yake kulipa kodi katika Israeli.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akauliza watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu naye, “Je, atafanyiwa nini mtu atakayemuua huyu Mfilisti na kuondoa aibu hii katika Israeli? Ni nani huyu Mfilisti asiyetahiriwa hata atukane majeshi ya Mungu aliye hai?”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wakarudia yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa na kumwambia kuwa, “Hili ndilo atakalotendewa mtu yule atakayemuua.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Eliabu nduguye mkubwa Daudi alipomsikia akizungumza na watu hasira ikawaka juu yake akamuuliza, “Kwa nini umeteremka kuja hapa? Nao wale kondoo wachache kule nyikani umewaacha na nani? Ninajua jinsi ulivyo na kiburi na jinsi moyo wako ulivyo mwovu; umekuja hapa kutazama vita tu.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akasema, “Sasa nimefanya nini? Je, siwezi hata kuongea.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akamgeukia mtu mwingine na kumuuliza jambo lilo hilo, nao watu wakamjibu vilevile kama mwanzo.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Lile Daudi alilosema likasikiwa na kuelezwa kwa Sauli, naye Sauli akatuma aitwe.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akamwambia Sauli, “Mtu yeyote asife moyo kwa habari ya huyu Mfilisti; mtumishi wako atakwenda kupigana naye.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Sauli akamjibu Daudi, “Wewe hutaweza kwenda kupigana dhidi ya huyu Mfilisti; wewe ni kijana tu, naye amekuwa mtu wa vita tangu ujana wake.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Lakini Daudi akamwambia Sauli, “Mtumishi wako amekuwa akichunga kondoo wa baba yake. Wakati simba au dubu alikuja na kuchukua kondoo kutoka kundi,

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: nilifuatia, nikampiga na nikampokonya kondoo kwenye kinywa chake. Aliponigeukia, nilimkamata nywele zake, nikampiga na kumuua.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mtumishi wako ameshaua simba na dubu pia; huyu Mfilisti asiyetahiriwa atakuwa kama mmoja wa hao, kwa sababu ameyatukana majeshi ya Mungu aliye hai.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Bwana ambaye aliniokoa toka katika makucha ya simba na makucha ya dubu ataniokoa kutoka mikono ya huyu Mfilisti.”
    Sauli akamwambia Daudi, “Nenda, naye Bwana na awe pamoja nawe.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Ndipo Sauli akamvika Daudi silaha zake mwenyewe za vita. Akamvika dirii na chapeo ya shaba kichwani mwake.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Daudi akajifunga upanga juu ya hayo mavazi na kujaribu kutembea kwa sababu alikuwa hana uzoefu navyo.
    Daudi akamwambia Sauli, “Siwezi kwenda nikiwa nimevaa hivi, kwa sababu sina uzoefu navyo.” Hivyo akavivua.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Kisha akachukua fimbo yake mkononi, akachagua mawe laini matano kutoka kwenye kijito, akayaweka kwenye kifuko ndani ya mfuko wake wa kichungaji, akiwa na kombeo yake mkononi mwake, akamkaribia yule Mfilisti.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wakati ule ule, yule Mfilisti, akiwa na mbeba ngao wake mbele yake, akaendelea kujongea karibu na Daudi.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mfilisti akamwangalia Daudi kote na kumwona kuwa ni kijana tu, mwekundu na mzuri wa kupendeza, naye akamdharau.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Akamwambia Daudi, “Je, mimi ni mbwa, hata unanijia na fimbo?” Yule Mfilisti akamlaani Daudi kwa miungu yake.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Tena Mfilisti akamwambia, “Njoo hapa, nami nitawapa ndege wa angani na wanyama wa mwituni nyama yako.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akamwambia yule Mfilisti. “Wewe unanijia na upanga, mkuki na fumo, lakini mimi ninakujia kwa jina la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa majeshi ya Israeli, ambaye wewe umemtukana.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Siku hii leo Bwana atakutia mkononi mwangu, nami nitakupiga na kukukata kichwa chako. Leo nitawapa ndege wa angani na wanyama wa nchi mizoga ya jeshi la Wafilisti, nayo dunia yote itajua kuwa yuko Mungu katika Israeli.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Wale wote waliokusanyika hapa watajua kuwa Bwana haokoi kwa upanga wala kwa mkuki; kwa kuwa vita ni vya Bwana, naye atawatia wote mikononi mwetu.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Yule Mfilisti aliposogea karibu ili kumshambulia, Daudi akaenda mbio kuelekea safu ya vita kukutana naye.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akatia mkono wake mfukoni na kuchukua jiwe, akalirusha kwa kombeo, nalo likampiga yule Mfilisti kwenye paji la uso. Lile jiwe likaingia kipajini mwa uso, akaanguka chini kifudifudi.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Basi Daudi akamshinda huyo Mfilisti kwa kombeo na jiwe; bila kuwa na upanga mikononi mwake akampiga huyo Mfilisti na kumuua.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Daudi akakimbia na kusimama juu yake. Akaushika upanga wa huyo Mfilisti na kuuvuta toka kwenye ala yake. Baada ya kumuua, akakata kichwa chake kwa ule upanga.
    Wafilisti walipoona kuwa shujaa wao amekufa, wakageuka na kukimbia.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Ndipo watu wa Israeli na Yuda wakainuka kwenda mbele wakipiga kelele na kufuatia Wafilisti mpaka kwenye ingilio la Gathi kwenye malango ya Ekroni. Maiti zao zilitawanyika kando ya barabara ya Shaaraimu hadi Gathi na Ekroni.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Waisraeli waliporudi kutoka kuwafukuza Wafilisti, waliteka nyara kutoka kambi yao.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Daudi akachukua kichwa cha yule Mfilisti na kukileta Yerusalemu, naye akaweka silaha za huyo Mfilisti katika hema lake mwenyewe.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Sauli alipomwona Daudi anakwenda kukabiliana na huyo Mfilisti, alimwambia Abneri, jemadari wa jeshi, “Abneri, yule kijana ni mwana wa nani?”
    Abneri akajibu, “Hakika kama uishivyo, ee mfalme, mimi sifahamu.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mfalme akasema, “Uliza huyu kijana ni mwana wa nani.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Mara Daudi aliporudi kutoka kumuua huyo Mfilisti, Abneri akamchukua na kumleta mbele ya Sauli. Daudi alikuwa bado anakishikilia kichwa cha yule Mfilisti.

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content:
Sauli akamuuliza, “Kijana, wewe ni mwana wa nani?”
    Daudi akasema, “Mimi ni mwana wa mtumishi wako Yese wa Bethlehemu.”

teaching.description: DAUDI APAKWA MAFUTA KUWA MFALME WA ISRAELI
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 16-17

content: Baada ya Daudi kumaliza kuongea na Sauli, roho ya Yonathani ikaambatana na roho ya Daudi, naye akampenda kama nafsi yake mwenyewe.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Kuanzia siku ile Sauli akamchukua Daudi naye hakumruhusu kurudi nyumbani kwa baba yake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Yonathani akafanya agano na Daudi kwa sababu alimpenda kama nafsi yake mwenyewe.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Yonathani akavua joho alilokuwa amevaa na kumpa Daudi, pamoja na koti lake, silaha zake, hata pamoja na upanga wake, upinde wake na mshipi wake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Lolote Sauli alilomtuma Daudi kufanya, alitenda kwa hekima, hata Sauli akampa cheo cha juu katika jeshi. Jambo hili likawapendeza watu wote, hata maafisa wa Sauli pia.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Watu walipokuwa wanarudi nyumbani baada ya Daudi kumuua yule Mfilisti, wanawake wakaja kutoka pande zote za miji ya Israeli kumlaki Mfalme Sauli kwa kuimba na kucheza, kwa nyimbo za furaha na kwa matari na zeze.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content:
Walipokuwa wanacheza, wakaimba:
  “Sauli amewaua elfu zake,
    naye Daudi makumi elfu yake.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akakasirika sana; sehemu hii ya kurudia rudia ya wimbo huu ilimkasirisha sana. Akafikiri kuwa, “Wamempa Daudi makumi elfu, lakini mimi wamenipa elfu tu. Apate nini zaidi isipokuwa ufalme?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Kuanzia wakati ule na kuendelea Sauli akawa na jicho la wivu juu ya Daudi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Kesho yake roho mbaya iliyoachiwa nafasi na Mungu ikaja kwa nguvu juu ya Sauli. Alikuwa akitabiri nyumbani mwake, wakati Daudi alikuwa akipiga kinubi, kama alivyozoea. Sauli alikuwa na mkuki mkononi mwake;

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: akautupa kwa nguvu, akijiambia mwenyewe, “Nitamchoma kwa mkuki abaki hapo ukutani.” Lakini Daudi akamkwepa mara mbili.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akamwogopa Daudi, kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Daudi, lakini alikuwa amemwacha yeye.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Kwa hiyo Sauli akamwondoa Daudi mbele yake na kumpa kuwa kiongozi wa watu elfu moja, naye Daudi akatoka na kuingia akiongoza vikosi katika vita.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Katika kila kitu alichofanya, Daudi alipata mafanikio makubwa, kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli alipoona jinsi alivyokuwa akifanikiwa, akamwogopa.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Lakini Israeli wote na Yuda walimpenda Daudi, kwa sababu ndiye alikuwa akiwaongoza katika vita vyao.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akamwambia Daudi, “Huyu hapa binti yangu mkubwa Merabu. Nitakupa umwoe, endapo tu utanitumikia kwa ushujaa na kupigana vita vya Bwana.” Kwa maana Sauli alisema moyoni mwake, “Sitainua mkono wangu dhidi yake. Acha mkono wa Wafilisti uwe juu yake.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Lakini Daudi akamwambia Sauli, “Mimi ni nani, nayo jamaa yangu ni nini au ukoo wa baba yangu katika Israeli, kwamba mimi niwe mkwewe mfalme?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Basi ulipofika wakati wa Daudi kupewa Merabu, binti Sauli, huyo binti aliozwa kwa Adrieli, Mmeholathi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Basi Mikali binti Sauli alimpenda Daudi, nao walipomwambia Sauli juu ya jambo hili, likampendeza.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akawaza, “Nitampa Daudi binti yangu, ili apate kuwa mtego kwake, ili kwamba mkono wa Wafilisti upate kuwa juu yake.” Hivyo Sauli akamwambia Daudi, “Sasa unayo nafasi ya pili ya kuwa mkwe wangu.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Ndipo Sauli akawaagiza watumishi wake, akisema, “Zungumzeni na Daudi kwa siri na kumwambia, ‘Tazama, mfalme amependezwa nawe, nao watumishi wake wote wanakupenda. Basi na uwe mkwewe mfalme.’ ”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Watumishi wa Sauli wakarudia hayo maneno kwa Daudi. Lakini Daudi akasema, “Je, mnafikiri ni jambo dogo kuwa mkwewe mfalme? Mimi ni mtu maskini tu, na nisiyejulikana sana.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Watumishi wa Sauli walipomweleza yale Daudi aliyoyasema,

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Watumishi walipomwambia Daudi mambo haya, ikampendeza kuwa mkwewe mfalme. Basi kabla siku iliyopangwa haijafika,

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Daudi na watu wake walitoka na kuwaua Wafilisti mia mbili. Akayaleta magovi yao na kupeleka hesabu kamilifu kwa mfalme, ili kwamba apate kuwa mkwewe mfalme. Ndipo Sauli akamwoza Daudi Mikali binti yake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli alipotambua kuwa Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Daudi na kwamba Mikali binti yake anampenda Daudi,

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akazidi kumwogopa Daudi, naye Sauli akabaki kuwa adui yake siku zote za maisha yake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Majemadari wa jeshi la Wafilisti waliendelea kupigana vita na kadiri walivyoendelea kupigana, Daudi akazidi kutenda kwa hekima kuliko maafisa wengine wa Sauli, nalo jina lake likajulikana sana.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akamwambia mwanawe Yonathani na watumishi wake wote wamuue Daudi. Lakini Yonathani mwana wa Sauli alimpenda sana Daudi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Yonathani akamwonya Daudi, akisema, “Baba yangu Sauli anatafuta nafasi ya kukuua. Ujilinde kesho asubuhi, nenda mahali pa siri na ukae huko.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Nitatoka na kukaa na baba yangu shambani mahali uliko. Nitazungumza naye juu yako, nami nitakueleza nitakachogundua.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Yonathani akanena mema juu ya Daudi kwa Sauli baba yake na kumwambia, “Mfalme asitende mabaya kwa mtumishi wake Daudi; hajakukosea, aliyoyafanya yamekuwa ya faida sana kwako.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Alihatarisha maisha yake alipomuua yule Mfilisti. Bwana akajipatia ushindi mkubwa kwa ajili ya Israeli wote, nawe uliuona na ukafurahi. Kwa nini basi utende mabaya kwa mtu asiye na hatia kama Daudi kwa kumuua bila sababu?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akamsikiliza Yonathani na kuapa hivi: “Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, Daudi hatauawa.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Basi Yonathani akamwita Daudi na kumweleza mazungumzo yote. Akamleta kwa Sauli, naye Daudi akawa pamoja na Sauli kama kwanza.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Vita vilitokea tena, naye Daudi akatoka na kupigana na Wafilisti. Akawapiga kwa nguvu nyingi hata wakakimbia mbele yake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Lakini roho mbaya iliyoachiwa nafasi na Bwana ikaja juu ya Sauli alipokuwa ameketi katika nyumba yake akiwa na mkuki mkononi mwake. Daudi alipokuwa anampigia kinubi,

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akajaribu kumchomea Daudi ukutani kwa huo mkuki wake, lakini Daudi akauhepa huo mkuki wa Sauli ukakita ukutani. Usiku ule ule Daudi akakimbia na kuokoka.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akatuma watu nyumbani mwa Daudi wailinde hiyo nyumba na kumuua asubuhi. Lakini Mikali, mkewe Daudi, akamwonya akisema, “Kama hukukimbia kuokoa maisha yako usiku huu, kesho yake utauawa.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Basi Mikali akamteremsha Daudi kupitia dirishani, naye akakimbia na kuokoka.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Kisha Mikali akachukua kinyago, akakilaza kitandani, akakifunika kwa vazi na kukiwekea singa za mbuzi kichwani.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli alipotuma watu kumkamata Daudi, Mikali akasema, “Yeye ni mgonjwa.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Kisha Sauli akatuma watu tena kumwona Daudi naye akawaambia, “Mleteni kwangu juu ya kitanda chake ili nipate kumuua.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Lakini wale watu walipoingia, kumbe ni kinyago tu kilichokuwa kitandani na kwenye kichwa kulikuwepo na singa za mbuzi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content:
Sauli akamwambia Mikali, “Kwa nini umenidanganya mimi hivi na kumwacha adui yangu aende zake ili apate kuokoka?”
    Mikali akamwambia, “Yeye aliniambia, ‘Niache niende zangu. Kwa nini nikuue?’ ”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Daudi alipokuwa amekimbia na kuokoka, alimwendea Samweli huko Rama na kumwambia yale yote Sauli alimfanyia. Ndipo Daudi na Samweli wakaenda Nayothi kukaa huko.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Habari zikamfikia Sauli kusema: “Daudi yuko Nayothi huko Rama.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Basi Sauli akatuma watu kumkamata Daudi, lakini walipoona kundi la manabii wakitoa unabii, wakiwa pamoja na Samweli akiwa amesimama hapo kama kiongozi wao, Roho wa Mungu akaja juu ya watu wa Sauli, nao pia wakatoa unabii.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Sauli akaelezwa juu ya hilo, naye akapeleka watu wengine zaidi, nao wakatoa unabii pia. Sauli akatuma watu mara ya tatu, nao pia wakatoa unabii.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content:
Mwishowe, yeye mwenyewe akaondoka kwenda Rama na kwenda hadi kwenye kile kisima kikubwa kilichoko huko Seku. Naye akauliza, “Wako wapi Samweli na Daudi?”
    Wakasema, “Wako Nayothi huko Rama.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Hivyo Sauli akaenda Nayothi huko Rama. Lakini Roho wa Mungu akaja juu yake hata yeye, akawa anatembea huku anatoa unabii hadi akafika Nayothi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Akavua majoho yake na pia akatoa unabii mbele ya Samweli. Akalala hali hiyo ule mchana kutwa na usiku kucha. Hii ndiyo sababu watu husema, “Je, Sauli pia yumo miongoni mwa manabii?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content:
Kisha Hana akaomba na kusema:
  “Moyo wangu wamshangilia Bwana,
    katika Bwana pembe yangu imeinuliwa juu.
  Kinywa changu chajisifu juu ya adui zangu,
    kwa kuwa naufurahia wokovu wako.

teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kisha Elikana akaenda nyumbani Rama, lakini mtoto akahudumu mbele za Bwana chini ya kuhani Eli.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Wana wa Eli walikuwa watu wabaya kabisa, hawakumheshimu Bwana.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Basi ilikuwa desturi ya makuhani pamoja na watu kwamba kila mara yeyote anapotoa dhabihu na huku nyama ikiwa inachemshwa, mtumishi wa kuhani angalikuja na uma wenye meno matatu mkononi mwake.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Angeutumbukiza huo uma kwenye sufuria au birika au sufuria kubwa au chungu, naye kuhani angalijichukulia mwenyewe chochote ambacho uma ungekileta. Hivi ndivyo walivyowatendea Waisraeli wote waliokuja Shilo.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Lakini hata kabla mafuta ya mnyama hayajachomwa, mtumishi wa kuhani angalikuja na kusema kwa mtu ambaye alikuwa akitoa dhabihu, “Mpe kuhani nyama akaoke, kwani hatapokea nyama iliyochemshwa kutoka kwako, ila iliyo mbichi tu.”

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kama mtu akimwambia, “Mafuta ya mnyama na yachomwe kwanza, ndipo uchukue chochote unachotaka,” mtumishi angalijibu, “Hapana, nipe sasa, kama huwezi nitaichukua kwa nguvu.”

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Hii Dhambi ya hawa vijana ilikuwa kubwa sana machoni pa Bwana, kwa kuwa waliitendea dhabihu ya Bwana kwa dharau.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Lakini Samweli alikuwa akihudumu mbele za Bwana, kijana akivaa kisibau cha kitani.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kila mwaka mama yake alimshonea joho dogo na kumchukulia wakati alipokwea pamoja na mumewe kutoa dhabihu ya mwaka.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Eli alikuwa akiwabariki Elikana na mkewe, akisema, “Bwana na akupe watoto kwa mwanamke huyu ili kuchukua nafasi ya yule aliyekuwa amemwomba na akamtoa kwa Bwana.” Kisha wakawa wanakwenda nyumbani.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Bwana akawa mwenye neema kwa Hana, naye akapata mimba akazaa wana watatu na binti wawili. Wakati huo, kijana Samweli akaendelea kukua mbele za Bwana.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Basi Eli, ambaye alikuwa mzee sana, alisikia kuhusu kila kitu ambacho wanawe walikuwa wakiwafanyia Israeli wote na jinsi walivyokutana kimwili na wanawake waliohudumu kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Hivyo akawaambia, “Kwa nini mmefanya mambo kama haya? Nimesikia kutoka kwa watu wote juu ya haya matendo yenu maovu.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Sivyo, wanangu, hii si habari nzuri ambayo ninasikia ikienea miongoni mwa watu wa Bwana.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kama mtu akifanya dhambi dhidi ya mtu mwenzake, mtu mwingine aweza kumwombea kwa Mungu, lakini kama mtu akimfanyia Mungu dhambi, ni nani atakayemwombea?” Hata hivyo wanawe hawakusikia maonyo ya baba yao, kwa sababu Bwana alitaka kuwaua.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Naye kijana Samweli akaendelea kukua katika kimo, akimpendeza Bwana na wanadamu.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Basi mtu wa Mungu akaja kwa Eli na kumwambia, “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: ‘Je, sikujifunua waziwazi kwa nyumba ya baba yako wakati walikuwa huko Misri chini ya Farao?

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Nilimchagua baba yako kati ya makabila yote ya Israeli kuwa kuhani wangu, kukwea kwenye madhabahu yangu, kufukiza uvumba na kuvaa kisibau mbele yangu. Pia niliwapa nyumba ya baba yako sadaka zote zilizotolewa kwa moto na Waisraeli.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kwa nini unadharau dhabihu zangu na sadaka zile nilizoziamuru kwa ajili ya makao yangu? Kwa nini unawaheshimu wanao kuliko mimi kwa kujinenepesha wenyewe kwa kula sehemu zilizo bora za kila sadaka zinazotolewa na watu wangu wa Israeli?’

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: “Kwa hiyo, Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asema: ‘Niliahidi kuwa nyumba yako na nyumba ya baba yako wangehudumu mbele zangu milele.’ Lakini sasa Bwana anasema: ‘Jambo hili na liwe mbali nami! Wale wanaoniheshimu nitawaheshimu, wale wanaonidharau mimi watadharauliwa.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Wakati unakuja nitakapozipunguza nguvu zenu na nguvu ya nyumba ya baba yenu, ili pasiwepo mtu katika mbari yenu atakayeishi kuuona uzee

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: nanyi mtaona huzuni katika makao yangu. Ingawa Israeli watafanyiwa mema, katika mbari yenu kamwe hapatakuwepo mtu atakayeishi hadi kuwa mzee.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kila mmoja wenu ambaye sitamkatilia mbali kutoka madhabahuni pangu atabakizwa tu kupofusha macho yenu kwa machozi na kuihuzunisha mioyo yenu, nao wazao wenu wote watakufa watakapokuwa wamefikia umri wa kustawi.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: “ ‘Kile kitakachotokea kwa wanao wawili, Hofni na Finehasi, kitakuwa ishara kwako. Wote wawili watakufa katika siku moja.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Mimi mwenyewe nitajiinulia kuhani mwaminifu, ambaye atafanya sawasawa na kile kilichoko moyoni mwangu na akilini mwangu. Nitaifanya nyumba yake kuwa imara, naye atahudumu mbele ya mpakwa mafuta wangu daima.

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kisha kila mmoja aliyeachwa katika mbari yenu atakuja na kusujudu mbele yake kwa ajili ya kipande cha fedha na ganda la mkate akisema, “Niteue katika baadhi ya ofisi ya ukuhani ili niweze kupata chakula.” ’ ”

teaching.description: SALA LA KINABII LA HANNAH
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 2 :1-3:1

content: Kisha Daudi akakimbia kutoka Nayothi huko Rama akamwendea Yonathani na kumuuliza, “Kwani nimefanya nini? Kosa langu ni nini? Nimemkosea baba yako kwa jinsi gani, hata kwamba anajaribu kuuondoa uhai wangu?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Yonathani akajibu, “La hasha! Hutakufa! Tazama, baba yangu hafanyi kitu chochote, kikubwa au kidogo, bila kuniambia mimi. Kwa nini anifiche hili? Sivyo ilivyo!”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Lakini Daudi akaapa na kusema, “Baba yako anajua kabisa kwamba nimepata kibali mbele yako, naye amesema moyoni mwake, ‘Yonathani sharti asilijue hili, la sivyo atahuzunika.’ Lakini kweli kama Bwana aishivyo na kama uishivyo, kuna hatua moja tu kati yangu na mauti.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI NA DAUDI WAFANYA AGANO
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 18:1-20:3

content: Yonathani akamwambia Daudi, “Chochote unachotaka nifanye, nitakufanyia.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Basi Daudi akamwambia, “Angalia, kesho ni sikukuu ya Mwezi Mwandamo, nami inanipasa kula chakula pamoja na mfalme; lakini niache niende kujificha shambani mpaka kesho kutwa.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kama baba yako akiona ya kuwa sipo, mwambie, ‘Daudi aliniomba sana ruhusa kuwahi Bethlehemu, mji wake wa nyumbani, kwa sababu dhabihu ya mwaka inafanywa huko kwa ajili ya ukoo wake wote.’

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kama akisema, ‘Ni vyema sana,’ basi mtumishi wako yu salama. Lakini kama akikasirika, unaweza kuwa na hakika kwamba anakusudia kunidhuru.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini kwa habari yako wewe, mtende wema mtumishi wako, kwa sababu mmeingia kwenye agano pamoja naye mbele za Bwana. Kama nina hatia, basi niue wewe mwenyewe! Kwa nini unikabidhi kwa baba yako?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akasema, “La hasha! Kama ningekuwa na kidokezo kidogo kwamba baba yangu amekusudia kukudhuru wewe, je, nisingekuambia?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akamuuliza, “Je, nani atakayeniambia kama baba yako atakujibu kwa ukali?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akamwambia, “Njoo, twende shambani.” Basi wakaenda huko pamoja.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kisha Yonathani akamwambia Daudi, “Ninakuahidi kwa jina la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, hakika nitamchunguza baba yangu wakati kama huu kesho kutwa! Kama ameweka utaratibu wa kufaa kukuhusu wewe, je, sitakutumia ujumbe na kukufahamisha?

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini ikiwa baba yangu amenuia kukudhuru, Bwana na anishughulikie kwa ukali, iwapo sitakufahamisha na kukuaga uende salama. Bwana na awe pamoja nawe kama alivyokuwa pamoja na baba yangu.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini nitendee wema usiokoma kama ule wa Bwana siku zote za maisha yangu, ili nisije nikauawa,

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: wala usiuondoe wema wako kwa jamaa yangu, hata kama ni wakati ule Bwana atakapokuwa amekatilia mbali kila adui wa Daudi kutoka kwenye uso wa dunia.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Basi Yonathani akafanya agano na nyumba ya Daudi, akisema: “Bwana na awaangamize adui za Daudi.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Naye Yonathani akamtaka Daudi athibitishe tena kiapo chake cha kumpenda, kwa sababu Yonathani alimpenda Daudi kama nafsi yake mwenyewe.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kisha Yonathani akamwambia Daudi, “Kesho ni sikukuu ya Mwezi Mwandamo. Itajulikana kwamba haupo kwa kuwa kiti chako kitakuwa hakina mtu.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kesho kutwa, inapokaribia jioni, nenda mahali pale ulipojificha wakati tatizo hili lilipoanza na usubiri karibu na jiwe la Ezeli.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Nitapiga mishale mitatu kando yake, kama kwamba nilikwenda kulenga shabaha.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kisha nitamtuma mvulana na kumwambia, ‘Nenda ukaitafute mishale.’ Kama nikimwambia, ‘Tazama mishale iko upande huu wako! Uilete hapa,’ basi uje, kwa sababu hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, wewe ni salama, hakuna hatari.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini kama nikimwambia huyo mvulana, ‘Angalia, mishale iko mbele yako,’ basi inakupasa uondoke, kwa sababu Bwana amekuruhusu uende zako.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kuhusu yale tuliyozungumza wewe na mimi: kumbuka, Bwana ndiye shahidi kati yako wewe na mimi milele.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Basi Daudi akajificha shambani, na sikukuu ya Mwezi Mwandamo ilipowadia, mfalme akaketi ili ale.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Akaketi mahali pake pa kawaida karibu na ukuta, kuelekeana na Yonathani, naye Abneri akaketi karibu na Mfalme Sauli, lakini kiti cha Daudi kilikuwa wazi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Sauli hakusema chochote siku ile kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Kuna kitu cha lazima kimetokea kwa Daudi ambacho kimemfanya najisi asihudhurie karamuni, hakika yeye yu najisi.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini siku iliyofuata, siku ya pili ya mwezi, kiti cha Daudi kilikuwa wazi tena. Kisha Sauli akamwambia mwanawe Yonathani, “Kwa nini mwana wa Yese hajaja chakulani jana wala leo?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akamjibu, “Daudi alinisihi sana nimpe ruhusa aende Bethlehemu.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Alisema, ‘Niruhusu niende, kwa sababu jamaa yetu wana dhabihu mjini, na ndugu yangu ameniagiza niwepo huko. Kama nimepata kibali mbele yako, niruhusu niende kuona ndugu zangu.’ Hii ndiyo sababu hakuja mezani pa mfalme.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Hasira ya Sauli ikawaka dhidi ya Yonathani na kumwambia, “Wewe mwana wa mwanamke mkaidi na mwasi! Je, sijui kuwa umekuwa upande wa mwana wa Yese kwa aibu yako mwenyewe na kwa aibu ya mama yako aliyekuzaa?

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Maadamu mwana wa Yese angali anaishi katika dunia hii wewe wala ufalme wako hautasimama. Sasa tuma aitwe umlete kwangu, kwa kuwa ni lazima afe!”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akamuuliza baba yake, “Kwa nini auawe? Kwani amefanya nini?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini Sauli akamtupia Yonathani mkuki wake kwa nguvu ili amuue. Hapo ndipo Yonathani alipotambua kwamba baba yake alikusudia kumuua Daudi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akainuka kutoka mezani kwa hasira kali. Siku ile ya pili ya mwezi hakula chakula, kwa kuwa alikuwa amehuzunishwa na vitendo vya aibu ambavyo baba yake alikuwa anamtendea Daudi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Kesho yake asubuhi Yonathani alikwenda shambani kukutana na Daudi. Alikuwa amefuatana na mvulana mdogo,

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: naye Yonathani akamwambia yule mvulana, “Kimbia ukatafute mishale nitakayorusha.” Mvulana alipokuwa akikimbia, akarusha mishale mbele yake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yule mvulana alipofika mahali pale ambapo mshale wa Yonathani ulipokuwa umeanguka, Yonathani akamwita, “Je, mshale hauko mbele yako?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akampigia kelele, “Harakisha, nenda haraka! Usisimame!” Mvulana akaokota mshale na kurudi kwa bwana wake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: (Mvulana hakujua chochote juu ya hayo yote; Yonathani na Daudi tu ndio waliojua.)

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Basi Yonathani akampa yule mvulana silaha zake na kumwambia, “Nenda, zirudishe mjini.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Baada ya mvulana kwenda, Daudi akainuka kutoka upande wa kusini wa lile jiwe, naye akasujudu uso wake mpaka nchi mara tatu mbele ya Yonathani. Kisha kila mmoja akambusu mwenzake, wakalia pamoja. Lakini Daudi akalia zaidi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Yonathani akamwambia Daudi, “Nenda kwa amani, kwa kuwa tumeapiana kiapo cha urafiki kati yetu kwa jina la Bwana, tukisema, ‘Bwana ndiye shahidi kati yako na mimi, na kati ya wazao wako na wazao wangu milele.’ ” Kisha Daudi akaondoka, naye Yonathani akarudi mjini.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akaenda Nobu, kwa Ahimeleki kuhani. Ahimeleki akatetemeka alipokutana naye, akamuuliza, “Kwa nini uko peke yako? Kwa nini hukufuatana na mtu yeyote?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akamjibu Ahimeleki kuhani, akisema, “Mfalme ameniagiza shughuli fulani na kuniambia, ‘Mtu yeyote asijue chochote kuhusu kazi yako wala maagizo yako!’ Kuhusu watu wangu, nimewaambia tukutane mahali fulani.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Sasa basi, una nini mkononi? Nipatie mikate mitano au chochote unachoweza kupata.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Lakini kuhani akamjibu Daudi, “Sina mkate wowote wa kawaida kwa sasa. Hata hivyo, ipo hapa mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, iwapo watu wamejitenga na wanawake.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akajibu, “Hakika tumejitenga na wanawake kwa siku hizi chache kama kawaida ya ninapotoka kwenda kwenye shughuli. Navyo vyombo vya wale vijana huwa ni vitakatifu hata kwenye safari ya kawaida, si zaidi sana leo vyombo vyao vitakuwa ni vitakatifu?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Hivyo kuhani akampa ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, kwa kuwa hapakuwepo mikate mingine isipokuwa hiyo ya Wonyesho iliyokuwa imeondolewa hapo mbele za Bwana na kubadilishwa na mingine yenye moto siku ile ilipoondolewa.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Basi siku hiyo palikuwepo na mmoja wa watumishi wa Sauli, aliyezuiliwa mbele za Bwana; alikuwa Doegi Mwedomu, kiongozi wa wachunga wanyama wa Sauli.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akamuuliza Ahimeleki, “Je, unao mkuki au upanga hapa? Sikuleta upanga wala silaha nyingine yoyote, kwa sababu shughuli ya mfalme ilikuwa ya haraka.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content:
Kuhani akajibu, “Upanga wa Goliathi Mfilisti, ambaye ulimuua katika Bonde la Ela, upo hapa, umefungiwa katika kitambaa nyuma ya kisibau. Kama unauhitaji, uchukue, hakuna upanga mwingine hapa ila huo tu.”
    Daudi akasema, “Hakuna upanga mwingine kama huo. Nipatie huo.”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Siku ile Daudi akamkimbia Sauli na kwenda kwa Akishi mfalme wa Gathi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content:
Lakini watumishi wa Akishi wakamwambia, “Je, huyu si ndiye Daudi mfalme wa nchi? Je, huyu si ndiye yule ambaye wanaimba katika ngoma zao wakisema:
  “ ‘Sauli amewaua elfu zake,
    naye Daudi makumi elfu yake’?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akayaweka maneno haya moyoni naye akamwogopa sana Akishi mfalme wa Gathi.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Basi akajifanya mwendawazimu mbele yao; naye alipokuwa mikononi mwao, alitenda kama kichaa, akikwaruza kwa kutia alama juu ya milango ya lango na kuachia udelele kutiririka kwenye ndevu zake.

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Akishi akawaambia watumishi wake, “Tazameni mtu huyu! Ana wazimu! Kwa nini mnamleta kwangu?

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Je, mimi nimepungukiwa na wenda wazimu kiasi kwamba mmeniletea mtu huyo hapa aendelee kufanya hivi mbele yangu? Je, ilikuwa ni lazima mtu huyo aje nyumbani kwangu?”

teaching.description: YONATHANI AMSAIDIA DAUDI KUKIMBILIA USALAMA
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 20:3-21:15

content: Daudi akaondoka Gathi na kukimbilia kwenye pango la Adulamu. Ndugu zake na watu wa nyumba ya baba yake waliposikia habari hiyo, wakamwendea huko.

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Kutoka huko Daudi akaenda Mispa huko Moabu na kumwambia mfalme wa Moabu, “Naomba uwaruhusu baba yangu na mama yangu waje kukaa nawe mpaka nijue nini Mungu atakachonifanyia.”

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Hivyo akawaacha wazazi wake wakae na mfalme wa Moabu, nao wakakaa naye muda wote ambao Daudi alikuwa ngomeni.

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Ndipo nabii Gadi akamwambia Daudi, “Usikae ngomeni. Nenda katika nchi ya Yuda.” Hivyo Daudi akaondoka na kwenda katika msitu wa Herethi.

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Basi Sauli akasikia kwamba Daudi na watu wake wameonekana. Sauli akiwa na mkuki mkononi, alikuwa ameketi chini ya mti wa mkwaju kwenye kilima huko Gibea, maafisa wake wote wakiwa wamesimama kumzunguka.

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Sauli akawaambia, “Sikilizeni enyi watu wa Benyamini! Je, mwana wa Yese atawapa ninyi nyote mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu? Je, atawafanya ninyi nyote majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia?

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Je, ndiyo sababu ninyi mkapanga hila mbaya dhidi yangu? Hakuna hata mmoja wenu ambaye ameniambia ni lini mwanangu alifanya agano na mwana wa Yese. Hapana hata mmoja wenu anayejishughulisha nami wala anayeniambia kwamba mwanangu amechochea mtumishi wangu kunivizia, kama afanyavyo leo.”

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Lakini Doegi Mwedomu, ambaye alikuwa akisimama na maafisa wa Sauli, akasema, “Nilimwona mwana wa Yese akija kwa Ahimeleki mwana wa Ahitubu huko Nobu.

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Ahimeleki akamuuliza Bwana kwa ajili yake; pia akampa vyakula na ule upanga wa Goliathi Mfilisti.”

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content: Kisha mfalme akatuma watu wamwite kuhani Ahimeleki mwana wa Ahitubu, na jamaa yote ya baba yake, waliokuwa makuhani huko Nobu, nao wote wakaja kwa mfalme.

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29

content:
Sauli akasema, “Sikiliza sasa, mwana wa Ahitubu.”
    Akajibu, “Naam, bwana wangu.”

teaching.description: DAUDI AKUSANYA MASHUJAA WAKE
teaching.name: 1 Samueli 22:1-23 :29
